Title:
Amendment to IFRS
16 3 Leases on sale
and leaseback
Effective date:
Annual periods beginning
on or after 1 January 2024
(Published September
2022)
Key requirements:
These amendments include requirements for sale and leaseback transactions
in IFRS 16 to explain how an entity accounts for a sale and leaseback after the
date of the transaction. Sale and leaseback transactions where some or all
the lease payments are variable lease payments that do not depend on an
index or rate are most likely to be impacted.
